jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
UK (Remote)

Up to £75k (dependent on experience), bonus, plus other benefits

A hands-on Project Manager role for someone who thrives in fast-paced delivery environments.

We're looking for a commercially minded Project Manager
who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and take ownership. This is not a role for someone who simply coordinates meetings and updates project plans. We need a delivery-focused Project Manager who can manage project budgets, produce accurate financial reporting, control scope, track project performance, and successfully navigate aggressive deadlines and changing customer requirements.

You'll be responsible for leading complex customer projects from inception through to completion, working closely with customers, technical teams, suppliers, Finance, Sales, and senior stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

If you enjoy accountability, solving problems, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward in a dynamic technology environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the successful delivery of assigned projects against time, cost, scope and quality, maintaining strong customer relationships throughout the lifecycle.
Coordinating internal teams and third-party suppliers to ensure successful delivery.
Managing project scope, budgets, timelines, risks and customer expectations.
Owning project commercials including forecasting, revenue recognition, invoicing, and track actuals against budget.
Initiate invoicing at the agreed milestones and secure the customer sign-off that releases payment, revenue and deliverable recognition
Acting as the primary customer contact throughout the project lifecycle.
Driving governance, reporting and stakeholder communication at all levels.
Managing change control processes and ensuring scope is effectively controlled.
Supporting bid activities, project proposals and customer renewals where required.
Mentoring junior Project Managers and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Experience

What We're Looking For

Significant experience delivering customer-facing technology projects.
Strong background within an MSP, Systems Integrator, Technology Reseller, Vendor, Professional Services or Consultancy environment.
A recognised project management qualification - PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent - with demonstrable application in live delivery
Strong commercial acumen: able to own a project budget, understand revenue recognition and margin, and make sound cost-versus-scope decisions.
Strong understanding of project governance, risk management and stakeholder engagement.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with senior customer stakeholders and executives.
Able to influence key decisions, resolve problems decisively, and hold internal and third-party parties to account.

Desirable

A good working understanding of modern networking and security technologies relevant to the portfolio - e.g. data networking, SD-WAN, cloud-delivered security and zero trust.
Experience delivering within a defined project governance framework and contributing to PMO standards, mentoring or continuous improvement.

Company Description

Xalient is a global boutique specialising in the convergence of identity-driven security and secure networking. We help the world's leading enterprises stay secure, connected, and ready for the future - bringing together deep technical expertise, business insight, and AI-powered innovation to solve the complex challenges of modern digital businesses.

Independent by design and driven by a passion for exceptional service, Xalient combines global reach with the agility and customer intimacy of a boutique provider. Our advisory, professional, and managed services teams operate across the UK, US, EMEA and Asia - delivering fast, tangible outcomes and long-term impact.

Xalient is trusted by forward-thinking enterprises to reduce risk, optimise performance, and navigate today's digital complexity with confidence.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy or maternity or age.

Our Commitment to Diversity

The Senior Project Manager
will oversee all aspects of projects. Lead, coordinate, and complete projects on time and within budget and scope. The responsibilities include to establish project plans with deadlines, assign responsibilities, monitor, and summarize progress of projects. The Senior Project Manager will coordinate with other departments to implement long and short projects that will align technology solutions and improve operational workflow. Successful projects will ensure that deliverables are on-time and fall within the applicable scope and budget. The Senior Project Manager will rely on his/her experience and judgment to plan and accomplish projects. A Senior Project Manager will lead and direct the work of others, accept ownership for accomplishing new and different requests and explore opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.

Assist in clearly defining the project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders, and ensuring operational and technical feasibility.

Responsible to ensure customer satisfaction that the work scope is completed in a quality manner, within budget and on time. Keep the business owner/stakeholder up to date to minimize uncertainty and avoid any unwanted surprises through effective communication. Meet with business owners to review current project status reports.
Perform other related duties as assigned. Examples: Develop spreadsheets, diagrams, and process maps to document needs.

4+ years RCM and healthcare project management experience, 4+ years leading RCM client integrations

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Micron Technology Inc. is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence. Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all, inspiring people to learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever.

Our Construction & Engineering team delivers the world-class facilities that support Micron’s manufacturing operations and innovation. Working across disciplines, the team creates safe, efficient, and reliable environments where employees can do their best work and where the company can grow and operate at scale.

About The Role

Micron is seeking a Project Manager to lead complex construction projects from concept through completion. You will take ownership of project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance, while coordinating multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. In partnership with internal groups, design professionals, contractors, and suppliers, you will guide projects through planning, design, procurement, construction, and closeout.

This role requires sound judgment, structured problem-solving, and the ability to bring teams together around clear project goals. You will help ensure that safety, environmental responsibility, quality, and technical excellence are incorporated into every phase of delivery. Your work will directly support Micron’s ability to expand and maintain the facilities essential to its global operations.

Qualifications

Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field, or relevant professional certification or licensing.
At least five years of experience serving as a primary project manager for highly technical construction projects.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing vendors, contracts, project budgets, and schedules.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data and structured methodologies to guide decisions.
Clear communication and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate priorities across multiple functions and workstreams.
Preferred: PMP or another recognized project management certification.
Preferred: Experience in semiconductor or similarly complex industrial construction environments.
Preferred: Background in process improvement, risk analysis, or failure mode analysis, and experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives.
Interest in developing or applying Agentic AI workflows to current or future processes is an advantage.

Responsibilities

Lead assigned construction projects, managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance from initiation through completion.
Promote compliance with Micron’s safety, environmental, and quality standards; identify potential hazards early and drive timely resolution.
Develop and maintain project financials, including estimates, forecasts, cash-flow plans, and cost controls.
Create and manage detailed project schedules, monitor progress, address constraints, and coordinate alignment across multidisciplinary teams.
Lead design reviews, competitive bidding, contract execution, project programming, and development activities.
Communicate project status, decisions, risks, and changes to relevant stakeholders, supporting informed and timely action.
Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, strengthen collaboration, and apply effective practices across project teams.

Benefits

Micron supports employees’ personal wellbeing and professional growth with benefits designed to promote health, provide peace of mind, and help prepare for the future. Depending on location and eligibility, team members can choose from medical, dental, and vision plans suited to their family’s healthcare needs and budget. Additional programs may include income protection if illness or injury prevents you from working, paid family leave, a robust paid time-off program, and paid holidays. Benefit offerings may vary by location. Please consult Micron’s Benefits Guide for details about programs available to you.

Equal Opportunity

Micron Technology Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Micron prohibits child labor and complies with applicable labor laws and standards. Micron does not charge candidates recruitment fees or request unlawful payments as a condition of employment. Candidates may use AI tools to support their application materials, but all information submitted must be accurate and reflect their actual skills and experience. Misrepresentation may result in disqualification. Job seekers should verify employment communications through Micron’s official careers website.

Prepare and deliver recurring project status updates and monthly reports summarizing activities, accomplishments, upcoming work, risks, and issues.
Define and improve processes that add structure, increase efficiency, and manage risk and flag issues early. Effectively communicate, provide resolutions and identify dependances.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and task trackers to support transparent execution and progress monitoring.
Ensure project activities align with established strategy, governance processes, and applicable standards.
Support contract compliance and maintain deliverable schedules.
Track and report on project goals, performance standards, and metrics against contract and Bixal standards.
Support budget management by tracking labor and funding against the contract.
Coordinate with vendors and contractor as needed.
Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform

Experience in activity planning, resource coordination and schedule management.
Experience managing projects across the full lifecycle including multi-task contracts and/or subcontracts of various types and complexity.
Experience supporting reporting, invoicing, contract compliance, performance management and quality assurance.
Experience working with cross-functional teams, senior management, clients and other stakeholders, including translating technical and Agile concepts for non-technical audiences.
Experience with Agile, Scrum methodologies and with human-centered design.
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office, and virtual collaboration tools such as Miro.
Strong written and oral communication, problem-solving, organization and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud Inference
jobs.description:
About Modular

At Modular, a Qualcomm company, we’re on a mission to revolutionize AI infrastructure by systematically rebuilding the AI software stack from the ground up. Our team, made up of industry leaders and experts, is building cutting-edge, modular infrastructure that simplifies AI development and deployment. By rethinking the complexities of AI systems, we’re empowering everyone to unlock AI’s full potential and tackle some of the world’s most pressing challenges.

If you’re passionate about shaping the future of AI and creating tools that make a real difference in people’s lives, we want you on our team. You can read about our culture and careers to understand how we work and what we value.

About The Role

Cloud Inference builds and operates the serving infrastructure behind Modular's inference products: Kubernetes-native, cluster-level orchestration that runs large language models in production for customers, on any cloud and across multiple hardware vendors. The team owns cluster orchestration, multi-cluster routing, and the deployment path that gets new model and engine versions safely into production.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You sit between Cloud Inference and the MAX product and customer-facing teams that depend on it, turning goals like higher throughput per GPU, lower cost per token, faster model bring-up, and fewer production incidents into work that ships. You work on systems carrying live customer traffic, where a rollout decision shows up in latency and spend the same day.

Working closely with engineering and product leaders, you bring structure to how work is planned, tracked, and communicated. You join design and capacity discussions, help teams build realistic plans, and surface risk early, shaping engineering decisions across the org.

LOCATION:
Candidates based in or open to relocating to the United States or Canada
are welcome to apply. You can work in our office in Los Altos, CA or remotely from home. Onboarding for new hires is conducted in-person in our Los Altos, CA office.

What You Will Do

Partner with engineering and product leaders to scope projects, set milestones, and sequence work against dependencies and available staffing.
Set and run the cadence for planning, status reporting, and risk review across Cloud Inference and the teams it depends on.
Drive execution on the path from a model or engine change to production traffic: bring-up, readiness gates, staged rollout, and rollback.
Coordinate customer production deployments and migrations end to end, including capacity, cutover plans, shadow traffic, and the communication around them.
Define and report the metrics that show whether the serving fleet is healthy and economical, including throughput per GPU, cost per million tokens, latency against customer targets, and deployment lead time. Use them to prioritize where to invest.
Run compute capacity planning with infrastructure and finance partners: forecast demand across clusters and hardware vendors, track utilization against commitments, and flag shortfalls before they block a launch.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure on the integrity of the deploy path, including access control on production clusters, secrets handling, and artifact provenance.
Strengthen production reliability: lead follow-through after incidents, drive root-cause analysis across teams, and make sure action items actually close.

What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or infrastructure engineering.
Experience with production cloud infrastructure at scale: distributed systems, Kubernetes, or GPU-backed services.
Experience running programs for AI inference or model serving in production, including latency and throughput targets under live customer traffic.
Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to make technical detail clear to people outside the work, including customers.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Helpful, But Not Required

Ability to reason about where a serving system loses performance or money, and to tell a real regression from noise.
Experience with capacity planning for GPU fleets, including forecasting, utilization, and vendor commitments.
Experience coordinating work across multiple hardware vendors or cloud providers.
Experience setting the planning and reporting cadence for an engineering organization.

What Modular Brings To The Table

Amazing Team. We are a progressive and agile team with some of the industry’s best engineering and product leaders.
World-class Benefits. In order to attract the best, we need to offer the best. Your benefits package may include comprehensive healthcare coverage, retirement and savings programs, employee stock purchase opportunities, paid time off, wellbeing resources, family support programs, and learning and development opportunities. Please note that specific benefit packages may vary based on your location, you can read more about benefits offered by Qualcomm here.
Competitive Compensation. We offer very strong compensation packages, including RSU grants. We want people to be focused on their best work and believe in tailoring compensation plans to meet the needs of our workforce.
Team Building Events. We organize regular team onsites and local meetups in Los Altos, CA as well as different cities. Traveling 2-4 times a year is expected for all roles.

Working at Modular will enable you to grow quickly as you work alongside incredibly motivated and talented people who have high standards, possess a growth mindset, and a purpose to truly change the world.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $187,000 – $207,000, which may vary by geographic location. Compensation also includes a competitive equity grant, an annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Your final offer will reflect your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:
U.S. citizen or national

Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We're hiring a Sr. Project/Program Manager to lead and manage the day-to-day operational and tactical aspects of multiple or enterprise scale projects, new initiatives and other ongoing business deliverables in accordance with business needs. This individual will identify, evaluate, and resolves issues that conflict with project deliverables. You'll collaborate closely with project team members, business owners and sponsors to develop and successfully implement projects/programs. Also, assess project risks, develop mitigation, and contingency plans. Lastly, you will oversee projects to ensure projects have required resources, meets milestones and are successfully implemented and lead and coordinate matrix and/or cross-functional team.

What You'll Do

Develops project plans and recommendations in support of Departmental/Company objectives and leads implementation; tracks and reports on the status of the project. Must ascertain, categorize and manage projects in relation to corporate priorities.
Negotiates for resources to staff projects effectively with appropriate skill sets, aligning skills to the needs of the project. Delegates work as required and ensures a quality end product through close customer contact and assesses customer/client satisfaction through direct feedback/evaluation.
Coordinates development and implementation of policies and procedures as well as development of compliance measurements. Controls and monitors project effectiveness; updates project plans as necessary. Ensures compliance with necessary audit requirements.
Represents BCBSNC in meetings with external parties including consultants, vendors, and others and may include service delivery management of vendors.
Assists with analysis and development of business processes to ensure quality, cost effectiveness, timeliness of customer service, and regulatory requirements and mandates are met.
Develops escalation process to channel issues and concerns to appropriate parties.
Evaluates project risks, developing contingency plans and responding to change in risk as the project progresses.
Develops effective business process improvement initiatives and communication plans.
Performs analytic functions and coaches others in analytical production, technical and other areas.
Proposes a variety of solutions to business issues/problems utilizing appropriate analysis tools (ie Cost/Benefit Analysis, Flowcharting, etc).
Documents and presents project management results through the development of criteria, issue analysis papers and reports; ensures that projects established objectives such as financial goals, where applicable and creates an evaluation plan to assess project performance in relation to stated goals.
Develops and tracks budgets, operating plans and financial cost forecasts to support the objectives of the project.
Provides indirect reports, if applicable, with well-defined expectations, ongoing feedback, coaching/ mentoring and/or training.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree or advanced degree (where required)
5+ years of experience in related field.
In lieu of degree, 7+ years of experience in related field.

Salary Range

At Blue Cross NC, we take great pride in a fair and equitable compensation package that reflects market-price and our starting salaries are typically planned near the middle of the range listed. Compensation decisions are driven by factors including experience and training, specialized skill sets, licensure and certifications and other business and organizational needs. Our base salary is part of a robust Total Rewards package that includes an Annual Incentive Bonus*, 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off (PTO), and competitive health benefits and wellness programs.

Based on annual corporate goal achievement and individual performance.

$89,174.00 - $142,679.00

Skills

Business Process Improvements, Implementation Management, Process Improvement Initiatives, Process Improvements, Project Management, Project Management Oversight, Project Performance Management (PM), Project Plan Development, Resource Management, Resource Planning

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Water)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grow here.

We are proud to have been appointed to all three Flood Risk and Asset Management (FRAM) Lots, the first to be announced under the UK Government Commercial Agency
’s Construction Professional Services 2 (CPS2) Framework.

The award deepens our 25-year partnership with the Environment Agency
, through delivering our expert technical, environmental, and commercial and programme services across flood and coastal risk management.

We will support the Environment Agency in ensuring the safe and efficient delivery of their record investment programme, reducing flood risk, and delivering projects that protect communities and benefit the environment.

Ie are looking for Senior Project Managers and Associate Project Managers, with a history of delivering in the Water industry to join our Infrastructure Project Management team to work on the FRAM across our North, Midlands and Scotland Region operating from 8 regional offices.

Our growth trajectory is strong, supported by a robust pipeline of projects and you will be joining a growing team of like-minded people that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be expected to work with other Seniors, Associates or Project Directors to successfully manage, coordinate and deliver water projects.

The role will cover the whole project lifecycle from initial inception, through the design and procurement process and onto the site delivery and commissioning phase.

Here’s what you’ll do

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be expected to lead a team to successfully manage and deliver capital investment projects. This role involves providing client-side project management support during all stages of the project delivery lifecycle from option studies, option development, and construction tender support through to NEC contract administration and on-site delivery.
Lead the successful delivery of multi-disciplinary complex projects within collaborative delivery teams
Provide effective support and mentoring to Project Managers, Graduates and Apprentices.
Establish and maintain governance arrangements for the delivery of projects, defining clear roles, responsibilities and accountabilities that align with organisational practice.
Client-side project management, including stakeholder, H&S, risk, quality, schedule, and contract management
Ensure projects and commissions are delivered to the satisfaction of the client for quality, cost, and time
Support and manage the project team ensuring appropriate resources are provided on projects, meeting the client and business requirements
Actively manage subcontractors and resources remote from the core project team
Develop strong relationships with clients and members of the cross-functional team
Support business development opportunities with existing and new clients
Manage the submission of project management bids.

If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, AECOM welcomes you. Join our team, where we don't just construct infrastructure but also uplift communities and enhance lives. Why not give our AECOM page on LinkedIn a follow to stay updated on the impactful projects we're working on and see firsthand the difference we're making in the industry!

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Infrastructure project management experience (Water industry experience desirable)
Experience of NEC suite of contracts, particularly the Professional Services Contract (PSC) and Engineering and Construction Contract (ECC) ideally NEC ECC Accredited
Experience of working as part of an integrated, multi-organisation, collaborative teams
Excellent communication and organisational skills
Highly motivated with a growing industry network
Relationship building skills –ability to build strong relationships with clients, teams, and stakeholders as well as an ability to build and maintain networks of business contacts.
Able to work under own initiative where appropriate working closely with the Senior Project Managers and Associates in the delivery of some of our projects.
A team player with a ‘can-do’ attitude, outgoing, polite, patient, diplomatic, personable, respectful, and flexible
Experience of working within a client organisation, either directly or through a co-location/secondment arrangement.
Excellent IT Skills and the ability to utilize current digital tools.
Excellent numeracy, verbal and written communication skills.
Experience of preparing bid submissions.
Ability to manage client relationships effectively both internally and externally.
Prior team and line management experience with clear leadership skills.

Education, Professional Qualifications Requirements

The individuals proposed for the role will ideally demonstrate the following:

A minimum 6 years of proven experience in a consulting environment providing a full spectrum of PM services including chairing meetings, minuting or proactively engaging in discussions, developing the PEP, progress reports, and tender documentation. General post contract management and administration, proactively engaging with relevant stakeholders, being aware of the scope of service and ensuring we deliver within the agreed parameters.
A relevant degree such as in project management, engineering, environmental science, construction, or relevant subject.
Demonstrable experience of NEC3 and NEC4 contract management
A project management qualification such as the APM PMQ or PRINCE2 would be desirable.
A member of a related professional body preferably chartered (APM, CIOB, ICE, RICS) would be desirable.
You may be required to undertake and successfully complete security screening checks.

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: IS Project Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Service Owner

__

IS Project Manager

In this role, you will lead strategic Information Systems (IS) projects that support digital transformation, business process improvement, and operational excellence across the Sales and Service Operations domain. You will be responsible for driving delivery from initiation through deployment, ensuring projects achieve agreed business outcomes while aligning stakeholders, managing risks, and maintaining effective governance.

Each day, you will plan, coordinate, and deliver IS initiatives across Salesforce platforms, enterprise integrations, and service operations. You will serve as the primary point of accountability for project execution, stakeholder alignment, delivery governance, and business value realization.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ().

Preferred locations are: Krakow
(Poland), Helsinki
(Finland), or Bangalore
(India).

This role is contributing to the IS Sales and Service Operations Domain for ELDS and ELSE
organization and reports to the IS Domain Lead.

You will be mainly accountable for

Leading end-to-end delivery of medium to large-scale IS projects using Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid methodologies.
Defining project scope, objectives, timelines, governance structures, success criteria, and business outcomes together with key stakeholders.
Driving cross-functional teams consisting of Business Process Owners (BPOs) business SMEs, product owners, architects, developers, testers, integration specialists, change managers, and delivery partners.
Ensuring successful delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, adoption targets, and business outcomes, while acting as the primary point of contact for business and IT stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle and leading governance forums, Steering Committees, project reviews, and status reporting activities.
Managing stakeholder expectations, facilitating decision-making, resolving delivery roadblocks, capturing lessons learned, and driving continuous improvement of project delivery practices; communicating delivery progress, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly to business and technology leadership.
Identifying, tracking, and mitigating project risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints through effective RAID management.
Leading Salesforce and digital transformation initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and platform standards.
Managing external vendors and delivery partners to ensure successful execution of project deliverables, driving organizational change, business readiness, stakeholder adoption, and successful transition into operational support.
Leveraging Azure DevOps to manage project plans, delivery roadmaps, work items, dependencies, progress reporting, and governance tracking.

Qualifications For The Role

You are highly skilled in project management methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery approaches, and you have a proven track record of independently driving project governance, stakeholder alignment, escalation management, and delivery execution.
You have 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale Information Systems projects, and have been leading Salesforce-related initiatives involving Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or CRM transformation programs for 3 years or more.
You have strong experience managing global, cross-functional teams across business and IT organizations, external vendors, system integrators, and consulting partners; you possess strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills.
You have strong experience using Azure DevOps for project planning, backlog management, sprint execution, release tracking, dependency management, reporting, and delivery governance; you are proficient in project collaboration and documentation tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft 365.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Program Manager, Startup Intelligence and Growth
jobs.description:
Overview

A startup’s next product milestone drives new design, simulation, test and validation requirements. Keysight is building a startup accelerator program to recognize those milestones and help our teams act on them. We are looking for a senior GTM engineer that combines strong research, cross-functional program management, and data orchestration skills to identify and drive clear startup account priorities and coordinated action.

This is a senior individual contributor position with global program ownership. You will influence teams across regions, partnering with product teams, business development, and sales leaders who own customer relationships and closing. You will create an end-to-end system and be accountable for research quality, program execution, adoption, and reporting on measurable contributions to pipeline and growth from a targeted list of startups. You will combine internal data and external signals, build practical automation, and drive execution, reporting moonthly on progress against a target account list. Your work will shape how and when we approach startups, identify expansion potential, and how we improve the program as we learn.

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Responsibilities

Overview

You Will Help Build a Program With a Clear Path From Your Research To Customer Conversations And Growth. The Work Offers Exposure To Startups Developing New Technologies, Collaboration With Keysight’s Technical And Commercial Teams, And Ownership Of The Systems And Operating Practices That Make The Program Repeatable Across Regions. It Will Emphasize 3 Core Areas

Startup account intelligence

Build and maintain a prioritized startup account list and concise, source-backed profiles covering technology, business model, stage, funding, product milestones, technical needs and commercial potential.
Investigate signals such as product launches, technical hiring, new facilities and development milestones. Connect these with account, purchase and engagement information to identify a credible reason to engage.
Work with sales, product and application experts to new startup and growth startup needs to relevant Keysight capabilities and invent new commercial offers as needed. Make evidence, assumptions and gaps clear so sellers can validate the opportunity.

Global program management and reporting

Drive the integrated program plan across regional marketing, product, business development and sales teams, with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and follow-through.
Create a shared account-level view of engagement, handoff status, next actions, opportunity progression and outcomes across the targeted account list.
Lead regular regional operating reviews and prepare clear executive updates starting with pipeline and order growth from the target accounts. Surface stalled accounts, inconsistent execution, or resource constraints, and coordinate resolution.

Automation and continuous improvement

Build and improve practical workflows for research, enrichment, signal monitoring, nurturing, scoring, and reporting using approved AI, analytics and automation tools.
Partner with systems and data specialists on integrations that require deeper engineering. Document the workflows you build and help teams adopt them.
Use conversion data, seller feedback and measured time savings to improve prioritization and decide which workflows deserve further investment.

Qualifications

Requirements:

6+ years of relevant experience in GTM program management, which may include revenue or marketing operations, market intelligence, startup programs, GTM engineering or a related B2B function. We value demonstrated ownership and results alongside years of experience.
Strong research skills, including the judgment to evaluate conflicting sources and turn incomplete information into a useful commercial hypothesis, and technical acumen to recognize when a startup could be a good fit for Keysight.
A record of leading cross-functional programs with clear plans, reporting, risk management and accountability across teams or regions.
Hands-on experience with GTM data, dashboards, and workflow automation. You can analyze account and funnel data using spreadsheets, including querying and extending analytics dashboards.
An understanding of new-customer acquisition and customer expansion, and the ability to connect your work to accepted opportunities and business outcomes.
Clear writing, effective stakeholder communication and the ability to influence without direct authority. You are comfortable learning technical markets and partnering with specialists.

Experience That Will Help You Stand Out

Experience researching or supporting startups, emerging technology markets or investor and accelerator ecosystems.
Familiarity with electronic design, simulation, test and validation requirements in markets such as semiconductors, AI infrastructure, wireless, aerospace, automotive or quantum technology.
Practical GTM engineering experience with enrichment and orchestration platforms such as Clay, business intelligence tools such as Snowflake and Tableau, and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Previous experience scripting in Python or JavaScript, account matching or scoring experience, or evidence that you have made AI-assisted research more accurate and useful.

You do not need experience with every tool or market listed. We welcome different educational and career paths, including equivalent practical experience. If you have built trusted research and helped commercial teams use it, we would like to understand your work.

Pay Range

USD $126,830.00 - USD $211,380.00 Year

jobs.title: Program Manager, DFR - DOJ
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

Skydio is looking for a driven customer facing Program Manager with a deep sense of ownership to lead and drive all aspects of implementation and delivery for our Federal Law Enforcement Customers.

You will join our Mission Success team, and will be Skydio's Law Enforcement customer liaison with Department of Justice (DOJ) accounts and broadly responsible for the success of our contracts to include: project planning, technical execution, risk management, problem solving, budget, performance improvements and scheduling. In this role, you will have to learn technical concepts and employ them quickly. Digging into the details to understand program dependencies so that technical and program risks can be managed effectively is a must. You will be expected to utilize your technical capability in conjunction with your program management skills to deliver the best outcome for customers. A successful candidate for this job should have deep experience working within the U.S. Law Enforcement or military and experience engaging with high-level officials through field operations.

In addition to your core role, you will also be responsible for providing input into a wide range of technical activities within the company. You will work in a high-activity/fast-paced environment, with the ability to handle ambiguity, and multiple tasks or projects at once. Your teammates are passionate Customer Success and Technical Support teams, but you’ll also work with broader teams such as Product, Marketing, and Engineering.

How You Will Make An Impact

Be a highly collaborative, requirements driven planner with a deep sense of ownership and accountability with a willingness to roll up sleeves and dive into the details.
Plan and design end-to-end project deployment and integration activities to ensure the successful launch of our platform and ensure operational success. Manage production and implementation programs against cost, schedule and technical requirements.
Understand customer requirements and translate them to Skydio’s agile product and technical teams to drive development and delivery execution.
Establish relationships with the Federal Law Enforcement customer and be technical enough to build & drive plans with Skydio’s engineering teams to meet milestones.
Inform Skydio and customer business and program leaders regarding contract management risks and opportunities, ensuring a coordinated and comprehensive approach to product delivery across the program.
General support of go-to-market & business activities, as required.

What Makes You A Good Fit

Experience as a customer-facing professional services / program manager, or in a similar high-tier complex and multifaceted role for federal law enforcement agencies.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including interaction with senior leaders and a strong focus on project management tools and concepts.
Proven track record of implementing new technology, agile development and interfacing with technical teams to deliver on customer schedules.
Experience in implementing effective internal business systems, processes and controls (hardware, software, operations) for management of large scale customer projects in the Law Enforcement field
Experience with unmanned systems, robotics, defense technology, or mission-critical hardware/software platforms preferred, particularly in operationally deployed environments.
Law Enforcement/Federal Program Management experience, to include: Technology Assessments, Systems Design, Systems Analysis, Programmatic Support, Acquisition Planning, and Budget Planning.
Outstanding analytical thinker and problem solver, comfortable working in data analytics and able to resolve complex problems independently. Thinking ‘out of the box’ and to develop creative solutions

Requirements

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance (if applicable).
Ability to travel up to 50% to DOJ customer sites, exercises, and program reviews.
Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $180,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
About Modular

At Modular, a Qualcomm company, we’re on a mission to revolutionize AI infrastructure by systematically rebuilding the AI software stack from the ground up. Our team, made up of industry leaders and experts, is building cutting-edge, modular infrastructure that simplifies AI development and deployment. By rethinking the complexities of AI systems, we’re empowering everyone to unlock AI’s full potential and tackle some of the world’s most pressing challenges.

If you’re passionate about shaping the future of AI and creating tools that make a real difference in people’s lives, we want you on our team. You can read about our culture and careers to understand how we work and what we value.

About The Role

Platform Engineering is responsible for the build, test, and deployment systems that ship MAX/Mojo as well as enabling teams to build & ship code faster with AI. This is a hands-on, technical role at the center of Modular's engineering org. You sit between Platform Engineering and the compiler, runtime, kernel, cloud, and product teams that depend on it, turning broad goals like faster builds, reliable tests, and shorter CI feedback loops into work that ships.

Working closely with engineering and product leaders, you bring structure to how work is planned, tracked, and communicated. You join design discussions, help teams build realistic plans, and surface risk early, shaping engineering decisions across the org.

LOCATION:
Candidates based in or open to relocating to the San Fransisco Bay Area
are welcome to apply. You can work in our office in Los Altos, CA or remotely from home. Onboarding for new hires is conducted in-person in our Los Altos, CA office.

What You Will Do

Partner with engineering and product leaders to scope projects, set milestones, and sequence work against dependencies and available staffing.
Set and run the cadence for planning, status reporting, and risk review across the org.
Drive execution on the build, release, and continuous deployment infrastructure behind MAX, Mojo, and Cloud, shortening the path from merge to production and keeping rollouts and rollbacks safe and routine.
Define and report the metrics for developer experience health, including build time, CI queue time, test flakiness, and time to merge. Use them to prioritize where to invest.
Partner with Security on the integrity of the build and release path — secrets handling in CI, runner and artifact isolation, signing and provenance, and access control on deploy paths.
Coordinate rollouts and migrations across teams, with clear communication, rollback plans, and adoption tracking.
Strengthen reliability of developer infrastructure: lead follow-through after incidents, drive root-cause analysis across teams, and make sure action items actually close.

What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or infrastructure engineering.
Experience driving programs for platform or developer infrastructure teams at scale, such as build systems, CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, or release tooling.
Experience leading cross-functional programs with multiple teams and dependencies, from scoping and planning through delivery.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical work to a range of audiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Helpful, But Not Required

Experience building or operating release and deployment infrastructure, including continuous deployment.
Ability to diagnose and improve build performance, test reliability, and pipeline throughput.
Experience working with compiler, systems software, or AI/ML infrastructure teams.
Experience setting the planning and reporting cadence for an engineering organization.
Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to make technical detail clear to people outside the work.

What Modular Brings To The Table

Amazing Team. We are a progressive and agile team with some of the industry’s best engineering and product leaders.
World-class Benefits. In order to attract the best, we need to offer the best. Your benefits package may include comprehensive healthcare coverage, retirement and savings programs, employee stock purchase opportunities, paid time off, wellbeing resources, family support programs, and learning and development opportunities. Please note that specific benefit packages may vary based on your location, you can read more about benefits offered by Qualcomm here.
Competitive Compensation. We offer very strong compensation packages, including RSU grants. We want people to be focused on their best work and believe in tailoring compensation plans to meet the needs of our workforce.
Team Building Events. We organize regular team onsites and local meetups in Los Altos, CA as well as different cities. Traveling 2-4 times a year is expected for all roles.

Working at Modular will enable you to grow quickly as you work alongside incredibly motivated and talented people who have high standards, possess a growth mindset, and a purpose to truly change the world.

The estimated base salary range for this role to be performed in the US, regardless of the state, is $143,400.00 - $277,200.00 USD
.

The salary for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of permissible, non-discriminatory job-related factors, which include but are not limited to education, training, work experience, business needs, or market demands. This range may be modified in the future. The total compensation for a candidate will also include annual target bonus, equity, and benefits.

For candidates who fall outside of the listed requirements, we nevertheless encourage you to apply as we may have upcoming openings that are lower/higher level than the ones advertised.

jobs.description:
Req ID:
398392

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Enterprise PMO Governance Project Manager to join our team in Springfield, Illinois (US-IL), United States (US).

Overview:

NTT DATA seeks an experienced Enterprise PMO Governance Project Manager to support the Illinois Medicaid Enterprise System (IL MES) Planning and Advisory Support Services (PASS) Program. This role will design, implement, and operate enterprise governance across multiple projects, vendors, and workstreams. The position will establish governance bodies, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, governance calendars, and integrated Risk, Issue, Action, and Decision (RAID) processes. The successful candidate will facilitate executive and program governance forums, translate detailed program information into concise leadership reporting, and maintain traceability among contractual obligations, deliverables, decisions, risks, and project execution. The role requires strong process-design, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and Microsoft 365 skills in a large-scale, highly regulated technology transformation environment.

Location: Remote.

Job Responsibilities Include:

Design, implement, and operate an enterprise PMO and program governance framework aligned with program objectives, contractual obligations, and delivery needs.
Establish governance bodies, decision rights, escalation paths, approval authorities, stage gates, governance calendars, and meeting cadences.
Develop and maintain governance plans, charters, procedures, standards, templates, RACI matrices, decision frameworks, and executive reporting artifacts.
Create consistent portfolio and program governance practices across multiple projects, vendors, workstreams, and delivery methodologies.
Establish and oversee integrated risk, issue, action item, decision, dependency, and escalation management processes and repositories.
Define escalation criteria, ownership expectations, aging thresholds, resolution workflows, approval processes, and traceability from issue identification through decision and closure.
Establish and facilitate steering committees, executive alignment meetings, architecture and governance boards, working groups, and other decision-making forums.
Prepare agendas, decision briefs, executive dashboards, governance reports, leadership presentations, meeting outcomes, and action follow-up materials.
Develop governance KPIs, metrics, dashboards, and management reporting that provide visibility into performance, aging, compliance, decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery health.
Assess current-state governance processes, identify gaps, and design practical future-state processes, controls, implementation roadmaps, and continuous-improvement actions.
Coordinate governance across client teams, contractors, implementation vendors, technical teams, project managers, business stakeholders, and other delivery organizations while maintaining clear accountability.
Maintain traceability among governance requirements, contractual obligations, deliverables, approvals, decisions, risks, issues, and project execution.
Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, quality, testing, procurement, certification, and program leadership functions to integrate governance across the transformation.
Build and maintain governance repositories, trackers, dashboards, and collaboration workflows using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Microsoft Lists.
Support workflow automation and process efficiency through Microsoft Power Automate and other approved Microsoft 365 capabilities, as applicable.
Promote governance discipline, transparency, accountability, timely decision-making, and continuous improvement across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery environments.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Project Management, Public Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience
8+ years of experience in project or program management, PMO governance, portfolio governance, transformation governance, or a related discipline.
5 years experience designing, implementing, and operating governance frameworks for large, complex programs involving multiple projects, vendors, or workstreams.

Preferred Skills:

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Strong experience establishing and overseeing RAID, dependency, decision, escalation, governance forum, and executive reporting processes.
Demonstrated ability to facilitate executives, program leaders, technical teams, project managers, business stakeholders, and vendors toward timely decisions and accountable action.
Experience developing governance artifacts, including plans, charters, procedures, RACI matrices, templates, standards, decision frameworks, dashboards, and leadership presentations.
Strong process-design and continuous-improvement capabilities, including current-state assessment, gap identification, future-state design, control definition, and implementation planning.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Microsoft Lists.
Excellent analytical, organizational, facilitation, written communication, verbal communication, and executive-presentation skills.
Experience applying Project Management Institute (PMI)-based program and project management practices.
SAFe or Agile governance experience; SAFe Agilist or a comparable certification is preferred.
Experience supporting state government, Medicaid, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment.
Experience with large-scale technology modernization or enterprise transformation programs.
Experience establishing governance for multi-vendor delivery environments with clear client, contractor, and vendor accountability.

IREX is a global solutions provider that partners with communities and institutions in the United States and around the world to cultivate leaders, expand access to education, and create economic opportunity. IREX seeks a Program Manager to lead the short-term component of a flagship international academic and professional exchange program and strengthen its foreign policy programming, strategic partnerships, major events, communications, and alumni engagement.

Job Summary

The Program Manager will bring substantive foreign policy expertise, strong professional networks, and senior-level external engagement experience to a flagship international academic and professional exchange program. Reporting to the Project Director, the Program Manager will lead the program’s short-term component for senior-level international professionals, including host institution selection, program design, Fellow advising, professional enrichment, and professional visits.

The Program Manager will translate U.S. foreign policy priorities into relevant programming and cultivate relationships with government, policy, business, academic, and nonprofit institutions. The position will also support professional affiliations and oversee major events, communications, and alumni engagement across the broader program.

We're looking for our next team member—could it be you?

What You’ll Do

Program Startup and Management: Support program transition and startup and manage assigned work plans, budgets, agreements, deliverables, risks, and compliance requirements.
Foreign Policy Integration: Translate U.S. foreign policy priorities into thematic programming, professional engagements, partnerships, events, communications, and participant experiences.
Program Leadership: Lead the program’s short-term component, including host institution recruitment and selection, program design, Fellow advising and support, logistics, professional enrichment, and executive-level engagements.
Strategic Partnerships and External Engagement: Cultivate relationships with U.S. government agencies, policy institutions, universities, businesses, nonprofits, and practitioner networks. Professional Affiliations: Strengthen the program’s network of U.S.-based professional affiliation hosts and help address specialized or senior-level placement needs across the broader program.
Events, Communications, and Alumni Engagement: Oversee major program events, including impact workshops and a high-profile forum, and guide program communications, external visibility, and alumni activities.
Representation and Collaboration: Represent IREX with the donor, host institutions, Fellows, alumni, and external stakeholders and collaborate closely with program and operational teams.
Team Leadership and Learning: Guide assigned staff and consultants, promote a collaborative and accountable team culture, and use stakeholder feedback and program data to improve implementation.

Skills & Experience

Demonstrated understanding of U.S. foreign policy priorities and institutions, with the ability to translate policy objectives into effective programming and partnerships.
An active U.S. and international professional network and demonstrated success engaging senior stakeholders across government, policy, business, academic, nonprofit, or practitioner communities.
Experience managing complex international exchange, fellowship, leadership, or professional-development programming, including host institution or partner management and participant support.
Experience designing senior-level professional programming, convenings, policy dialogues, professional visits, or similar external-facing initiatives.
Strong program management, writing, communication, judgment, cross-cultural engagement, and stakeholder-representation skills.
Experience supervising staff or consultants.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience with the U.S. Department of State or another U.S. Government foreign affairs, public diplomacy, or exchange program.
Experience working with senior government officials, policy experts, executives, diplomats, or comparable stakeholders.
Experience supporting program startup or transition and

Requirements

Advanced Degree (Masters and higher) in in international affairs, foreign policy, public policy, political science, economics, international development, business, law, regional studies, or a related field.
At least eight years of progressive experience in foreign policy, international affairs, public diplomacy, professional exchange, government relations, strategic partnerships, or a related field.

At IREX, you’ll work alongside committed, passionate, and collaborative colleagues who are united by a shared mission—making it a truly rewarding place to work. We offer learning, development, and growth opportunities, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your overall well-being.

If you are excited by IREX’s mission and see yourself contributing to this work, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience does not align with every preferred qualification. We value a range of backgrounds and experiences and are especially interested in candidates who bring curiosity, initiative, strong collaboration skills, and a commitment to meaningful global impact.

At IREX, our culture is built on our people—and on how we work together to create meaningful impact every day. We look for colleagues who bring purpose, intellectual curiosity, collaborative problem solving,
and a results driven,
bias for action to help strengthen communities and advance our mission.

Successful candidates build trust across differences, move ideas into action, seek new perspectives, embrace change
, and represent IREX with authenticity and professionalism. We value people who bring strong expertise and a generous team spirit to work that advances our mission.

To this end, IREX recruits, hires, trains, and promotes individuals based on merit and experience.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Sr. Program Manager works independently to define the scope of the program and bridges the requirements of the customer(s) to the outputs of each function within the global enterprise. Plans, directs, and coordinates activities of designated programs to ensure that goals and objectives of the programs are achieved or exceeded within prescribed time frame and funding parameters. Has a history of success collaborating with, while holding accountable, cross-functional team members to drive complex products through the development phase and into production. The role requires a highly organized mindset, an ability to capture command and control over other functions, a passion to launch new technologies and an unparalleled ability to pull people together to make things happen. This role works closely with the customer and is a window into the organization.

Responsibilities

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

Plans the project milestones and takes control of company resources assigned by the functions and aligns them towards successful launch. Exhibits Command and Control over associates and managers of other functions and provides leadership and direction for all program activities to include planning, organizing, and managing resources/processes to achieve and exceed program objectives within scope, time, quality, and budget constraints.
Develops and maintains high fidelity P/L cost models both locally and globally. Assists or Leads the simulation of different P/L scenarios to formulate conclusions and recommendations for best / advantageous course of action. Presents to company executives cost/sales price to win business and maintain profit. Tracks all elements contributing to P/L and drives other function team members for cost down (VA/VE) opportunities to closure.
Assists with or Leads Business Plan and Mid-Term Plan budget development process for portfolio of programs.
Drives others to execute work by building positive relationships including Manager level to ensure high level of integration and cross functional collaboration among Engineering, Sales, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance and Purchasing.
Leads various Cross-Functional Program Review Meetings both internally and externally with customers. Creates and maintains detailed and actionable OIL (Open Issues List) and Master Program Timelines and is the central control point for progress of Open Issues, roadblock resolution, risk mitigation and escalation.
Interacts with customers key decision makers to ensure alignment of expectations for deliverables. Champions the cross functional team to formulate and present consistent and properly messaged commitments and program updates to the customer.
Expert working knowledge of the Phase and Gate Process. Leads the Cross Functional team in following the Gate Process. This includes verifying all functional groups are progressing to the program milestones, activities and deliveries for each phase and are preparing their Gate Review meeting material for each Executive Gate Review on time and in full. Holds accountable each functional department to accomplish this.
In conjunction with the Sales Team, leads new business pursuits by creating business cases, pursuit strategy and risk analysis. Is the lead presenter to Executive Team to secure finalization of quote package for the customer.
Provides high level of direction and guidance to cross-functional team members and their managers.

Must-haves

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related degree required. Master’s degree highly preferred.
Minimum of five to seven (5-7) years of program management or related industry experience.
Automotive Industry end to end product launch experience preferred. Intermediate proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, Project and Outlook.

Benefits & Perks - We're All About You

Great Medical/Dental Benefits
Company-Matched 401K Retirement Savings
Annual Bonus Program
Educational Assistance
Relaxed Dress Code
PASATalks Speaker Summits
Leadership & Mentorship Programs
High5 Reward Recognition Program
Onsite Happy Hours
And many more benefits & perks found within the ‘Our Culture’ section…

At Panasonic, our technology and engineering expertise delivers innovation across diverse industries. It's all about the consumer experience and making sure that we find ways to enhance that experience, either through audio enhancements or through safety enhancements inside the vehicle.

Panasonic Automotive Systems Company of America (PASA) is an industry-leading global supplier to Automotive Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM’s) for infotainment systems and advanced connected car solutions. Our clients include Ford, GM, Chrysler, Daimler, Fiat, Tesla, Honda, Toyota.
